soleplate.name: Sole plate
soleplate.does: The steel plate over the pit the discharge head is bolted to, grouted into the floor.

head.name: Discharge head
head.does: Hangs the column and the bowls from the floor and turns the water out to the discharge branch; its motor stand carries the motor, with windows to reach the coupling and the seal.

seal.name: Packing box (shaft seal)
seal.does: Seals the shaft where it leaves the head, under the motor stand (packing or a mechanical seal).
seal.material: Cast iron box, packing rings or seal faces

shaft.name: Pump shaft (lineshaft and bowl shaft)
shaft.does: Carries the impellers in the bowls and runs up the column to the coupling, held central by the lineshaft bearings. Drawn as one shaft: a real one is in sections joined by threaded couplings at the column's joints.

discharge_case.name: Discharge case
discharge_case.does: Gathers the water from the top stage's bowl into the column; the column's lowest section is bolted to it.

bowl_2.name: Bowl, second stage
bowl_2.does: Holds the second impeller; its vanes turn the water from the impeller upwards to the next stage.

bowl_1.name: Bowl, first stage
bowl_1.does: Holds the first impeller, bolted to the suction bell below and the next bowl above.

suction_bell.name: Suction bell
suction_bell.does: The bell mouth the water comes in at from the pit, with the shaft's bottom bearing in its hub.

impeller_1.name: Impeller, first stage
impeller_1.does: An enclosed impeller, fastened to the shaft by its taperlock; its vanes, curved back against the way it turns, fling the water outwards and up into the bowl.

impeller_2.name: Impeller, second stage
impeller_2.does: The second stage's impeller, the same as the first, on its own taperlock.

coupling.name: Spacer coupling
coupling.does: Joins the pump's shaft to the motor's inside the motor stand; its adjusting nut sets the impellers' lift, and its spacer lets the seal be serviced without lifting the motor. Drawn as one piece with its hubs.

column_1.name: Column section 1
column_1.does: A length of the column pipe the water rises in, with its flanged joint below and the lineshaft bearing in its retainer there.

column_2.name: Column section 2
column_2.does: A length of the column pipe the water rises in, with its flanged joint below and the lineshaft bearing in its retainer there.

column_3.name: Column section 3
column_3.does: A length of the column pipe the water rises in, bolted to the discharge case below.

motor.name: Stator and frame
motor.does: The stator's core and winding in the motor's frame: its rotating field turns the rotor. The frame stands on the pump's motor stand by its mounting flange.
motor.material: Cast iron or steel frame, electrical steel laminations, copper winding

end_shield_de.name: Drive-end bracket (mounting flange)
end_shield_de.does: The flange the motor stands on, bolted to the motor stand, with the lower guide bearing's housing round the shaft.

end_shield_nde.name: Top bracket
end_shield_nde.does: Closes the frame at the top and holds the thrust bearing, which carries the weight of the turning parts and the pump's thrust.

drip_cover.name: Drip cover
drip_cover.does: The canopy over the top of the motor: it keeps rain and drips out of the fan and the top bracket.

fan.name: Cooling fan
fan.does: On the shaft's non-drive end: blows air along the frame's fins whichever way the motor turns (straight radial blades). A fan fitted with interference is replaced, not reused.

rotor.name: Rotor
rotor.does: The rotor's core on its shaft, hung in the thrust bearing; its shaft's lower end carries the coupling's motor half.
rotor.material: Electrical steel laminations, aluminium or copper cage, steel shaft

bearing_thrust.name: Thrust bearing (upper)
bearing_thrust.does: Carries the rotor's weight and the pump's downward thrust, passed up through the coupling.

bearing_guide.name: Guide bearing (lower)
bearing_guide.does: Keeps the shaft central at the drive end; it carries no thrust.

terminal_box.name: Terminal box
terminal_box.does: Where the supply cable lands on the winding's terminals U1, V1, W1; record the connections before it is opened.

text: The sole plate stays grouted into the floor over the pit.
Stand the pump shaft up; the bowls go on over it from the bell up.
why: In the shop the whole pump (the head with the column and the bowls) is lifted out of the pit and laid down to be taken apart; the steps here fit each part where it stands.

text: Fit the suction bell on the shaft's lower end, its bearing over the shaft.
needs: shaft
The bell goes on the shaft: stand the shaft up first.
Take the bell off before the shaft is laid down.

text: Slide the first impeller over the shaft until it seats in the bell, then drive its taperlock in.
why: Taking it apart, the impeller is driven off its taperlock with a taperlock driver.
needs: suction_bell
The first impeller seats on the suction bell: fit the bell first.
Take the first impeller off before the bell.

text: Slide the first bowl over the impeller and bolt it to the bell.
needs: impeller_1
The bowl closes over the first impeller: fit the impeller first.
Take the first bowl off before its impeller.

text: Slide the second impeller over the shaft and drive its taperlock in.
needs: bowl_1
The second impeller seats on the first bowl: fit the bowl first.
Take the second impeller off before the first bowl.

text: Slide the second bowl over the impeller and bolt it on.
needs: impeller_2
The bowl closes over the second impeller: fit the impeller first.
Take the second bowl off before its impeller.

text: Bolt the discharge case on top of the bowls.
needs: bowl_2
The discharge case sits on the top bowl: fit the bowl first.
Take the discharge case off before the bowls.

text: Bolt the lowest column section to the discharge case.
needs: discharge_case
The column stands on the discharge case: fit it first.
Take the lowest column section off before the discharge case.

text: Fit the next column section with its lineshaft bearing retainer.
needs: column_3
The column goes up section by section: fit the one below first.
Take the column sections off from the top down.

text: Bolt the joint between the two sections.
needs: column_2
The bolts join the two sections: fit the upper one first.
Take the joint's bolts out before the upper section comes off.

text: Fit the top column section with its lineshaft bearing retainer.
needs: column_2
The column goes up section by section: fit the one below first.
Take the column sections off from the top down.

text: Bolt the joint between the two sections.
needs: column_1
The bolts join the two sections: fit the upper one first.
Take the joint's bolts out before the upper section comes off.

text: Fit the discharge head on the top column section and lower the pump into the pit onto the sole plate.
needs: column_1
The head hangs the column: fit the top section first.
Take the head off before the column sections.
soleplate
The head stands on the sole plate: it is there first.
The sole plate stays grouted into the floor.

text: Bolt the head down to the sole plate and connect the discharge pipe.
needs: head
The bolts hold the head down: set it on the sole plate first.
Take the head's bolts out before the pump is lifted out.

text: Fit the packing box over the shaft into the head's top.
needs: head
The seal sits in the head's top: fit the head first.
Take the seal off before the head.

text: Set the motor's stator and frame on the motor stand and bolt its flange down.
why: Goulds and Flowserve lift the motor off first and set it on last. Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: head
The motor stands on the head's motor stand: fit the head first.
Lift the motor off before the head is unbolted.

text: The drive-end bracket (the mounting flange) comes with the frame.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: motor
The bracket closes the frame's bottom: set the frame first.
The bracket stays on the frame.

text: Lower the rotor into the stator, its guide and thrust bearings already on its shaft.
why: Lifted by an eyebolt in its shaft's top. Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: end_shield_de
The rotor's shaft goes down through the drive-end bracket: it is there first.
Lift the rotor out before the drive-end bracket is touched.

text: The lower guide bearing goes on the shaft before the rotor goes in.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: rotor
The bearing goes on the rotor's shaft: it is there first.
Take the bearing off once the rotor is out.

text: The thrust bearing goes on the shaft's top before the rotor goes in.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: rotor
The bearing goes on the rotor's shaft: it is there first.
Take the bearing off once the rotor is out.

text: Fit the top bracket over the thrust bearing.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: bearing_thrust
The bracket holds the thrust bearing: fit the bearing first.
Take the top bracket off before the rotor is lifted.
rotor
The bracket closes over the rotor: put the rotor in first.
Take the top bracket off before the rotor is lifted.

text: Fit the fan on the shaft's top.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: end_shield_nde
The fan sits above the top bracket: fit the bracket first.
Take the fan off before the top bracket.

text: Fit the drip cover over the fan.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: fan
The cover closes over the fan: fit the fan first.
Take the drip cover off first.

text: Fit the terminal box and connect the supply.
why: Order derived from how the motor is built, not from a manual: no public manual read gives a numbered dismantling sequence.
needs: motor
The terminal box is on the frame: set the frame first.
Take the terminal box off with the supply disconnected.

text: Fit the spacer coupling between the shafts and set the impellers' lift with its adjusting nut.
why: Turning the adjusting nut lifts the impellers just clear of their seats (Goulds p. 20).
needs: rotor
The coupling's top hub is on the motor's shaft: put the rotor in first.
Take the coupling out before the motor's rotor is lifted.
seal
The coupling turns above the seal: fit the seal first.
Take the coupling out before the seal.
motor
The coupling joins the pump to the motor: set the motor first.
Take the coupling out before the motor is lifted.
